[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-na[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Record walk: ‹ › links on every record, N of M painted live[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every record note carries one bob-maintained `‹ prev · ↑ album · [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]next ›` line that forms a cycling alphabetical ring per album, `[n`[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]/ `]n` follow it with no key changes, and Obsidian paints `N of M` [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]beside it on a record-sheet rail and in the `n` links footer, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]without ever writing a count into Markdown.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]8[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202611/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]record_walk_ring.md[/bold #87AFFF]
